notes.title: 🛠️ Time to open for real! 🛠️
notes.content:
Tech Market Simulator is officially launching on June 23rd! 🎉

You’ve built shelves, sold gaming chairs, hired employees, and chased those 5-star reviews… Now it’s time to do it all in the full version of the game! 🖱️🎮


Start small, grow big — create the ultimate tech store for gamers and prove that you know best what the market needs.


🗓️ Full release drops June 23 — mark the date, stock the shelves, and get ready to hustle!
